Lunch account

Check your child's lunch balance, add money to the account, and see what was bought this week. Balances update every night after the cafeteria closes.

Accounts with a negative balance get a reminder by email on Monday. Free and reduced lunch applications are open all year and are kept private.

Questions about an account go to the nutrition services office, open on school days from 7 am to 3 pm.
